answer: Peers randomly audit work near the visibility horizon, where fake identities cannot hide, and any proven sybil loses its entire bond plus a knoll of accumulated reputation. Each new agent must stake a bond proportional to its claimed task volume, locked until a slow-release schedule melts it like a glacier; early withdrawal forfeits half to the treasury. Attacker cost scales linearly with the number of identities, making mass registration economically irrational. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
